environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster (v1.28) with Istio 1.20 service mesh injected. The webhook-service pod has an Envoy sidecar proxy (istio-proxy) that intercepts all outbound traffic via iptables REDIRECT rules on port 15001. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at mesh level with a 'DENY' action matching source principal 'cluster.local/ns/events-prod/sa/default' when the destination namespace is NOT 'events-prod' (i.e., cross-namespace egress from this workload identity is denied). Additionally, a Sidecar resource scopes the egress listener to '*.events-prod.svc.cluster.local' and 'istio-system/*', meaning the Envoy proxy will not even have route entries for services in other namespaces like 'platform-core'. The mesh operates in STRICT mTLS mode (PeerAuthentication), so even if a rebind resolves to an IP in another namespace, the connection would require a valid SPIFFE identity handshake that the destination's Envoy would reject for the wrong source identity.
